verdict.rationale: Relay is a business banking SaaS that holds sensitive customer data, so whether that data is excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy-posture question for it. The evidence pack has no mention of an AI-training opt-out, a data-use policy, or any AI training practices at all. The llms.txt probe only shows AI-crawler-friendly documentation and says nothing about training on user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
